title: API Control
description: The direct control assignment gives complete control over the cab levers by mapping the gamepad lever value directly onto the game's HTTP API. May introduce slight overhead compared to direct control

controls.description: The direct/api control name to control; can be identified using the Cab Debugger

control_range.description: The control range that will be remapped to 0,1 or 0,-1. This is useful when direct mapping partial ranges.
